ABOUT Vitrified Tiles TILES

Understanding Vitrified Tiles

Manufactured under high pressure and extreme heat, vitrified tiles are built with a dense composition that reduces water absorption while improving strength and surface longevity.

Their clean finish and ability to withstand everyday movement make them ideal for spaces where durability matters as much as appearance.

HAVE QUESTIONS?

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about vitrified tiles, from water resistance and finishes to maintenance, durability, and everyday applications.

−

What are vitrified tiles best used for?

Vitrified tiles are ideal for homes, offices, retail spaces, and commercial interiors where durability and easy maintenance matter.

+

Are vitrified tiles suitable for high traffic areas?

Yes. Their dense surface structure makes vitrified tiles highly durable for spaces with continuous everyday foot movement.

+

Do vitrified tiles absorb water?

Vitrified tiles have very low water absorption which helps improve durability and makes them suitable for moisture prone spaces.

+

Are vitrified tiles easy to maintain?

Yes. Their smooth surface allows quick cleaning and requires very little maintenance for regular everyday use.

+

Do you supply vitrified tiles across Bangalore?

Yes. Jain Stones & Tiles supplies vitrified tiles across Bangalore for homes, builders, architects, and commercial projects.
